events.working_title: Trinity's capture turns into a massacre
events.why_here: The cops' breach and Trinity's surrender (sc-001) resolve into a single burst of violence when she breaks the cuffs and kills them all (sc-003); the intervening arrival of the Agents (sc-002) is the same beat's pressure closing in, and the question of whether she is taken changes decisively to her standing alone over the dead.

events.working_title: The Agents split to hunt her
events.why_here: After the room is cleared, the story pivots to the pursuers' repositioning: Brown and Smith diverge (one to the hotel, one to the alley), opening a new question of how the net closes rather than continuing the fight that just ended.

events.working_title: Trinity's escape across the rooftops to the phone
events.why_here: Trinity's flight from the compromised room (sc-005) launches a single continuous chase — hall, fire escape, rooftops, the dive through the window, the stairwell fall, and the street race to the booth — that only resolves when she answers the phone and vanishes while the Agents learn the name 'Neo' (sc-011), after which the pursuit's question is answered and the story turns to its new target.

events.working_title: Neo is summoned and drawn toward the truth
events.why_here: The machine intrusion commanding Neo to 'follow the white rabbit' (sc-012) pays off immediately when he follows the pin to the party where Trinity names his search and warns him (sc-013); together they answer who has been contacting him and what he is being pulled toward, before the thread cuts to his ordinary morning.

events.working_title: Neo's ordinary life reasserts itself
events.why_here: The night's pull recedes as Neo wakes late (sc-014), the setting of his workplace is established (sc-015), and his boss Rhineheart disciplines him (sc-016) — a unit answering what his 'real' life looks like, distinct from the underground summons that preceded it and the hunt that follows.

events.working_title: The Agents seize Neo at the office
events.why_here: Morpheus's warning call (sc-017) triggers Neo's flight through the office and onto the ledge (sc-018), which resolves in his capture and forced entry into the sedan (sc-019); the question of whether he escapes the closing Agents is answered by his being taken, and Trinity's distant reaction closes the beat.

events.working_title: Neo is interrogated and implanted
events.why_here: The capture gives way to a self-contained confrontation in the interrogation room where Smith's bargain fails and Neo is physically violated by the bug; this pivot stands alone because the question shifts from flight to bodily violation and coercion, and it ends with the violation complete.

events.working_title: Neo is reclaimed and taken to Morpheus
events.why_here: Waking from the ordeal (sc-021), Neo is collected on the bridge (sc-022), submits to the crew's terms in the car (sc-023), and is driven through the 'wet underworld' (sc-024) — one movement answering whether he will finally go to Morpheus, carrying him from his apartment to the road that ends his old life.

events.working_title: The Bug Removed
events.why_here: The question changes from whether Neo will join them to what is inside him; the extraction and the discarded tap reverting to a wire bug resolve the immediate physical threat, and the car coming to a stop at the hotel ends the journey that began on the bridge.

events.working_title: The Red Pill
events.why_here: Arrival at room 1313 reframes the situation around a final choice, Morpheus offers the two pills and Neo swallows the red one, committing irreversibly; the crew then locating and pulling his signal answers the new question of what the pill does, and Neo being swallowed into darkness ends the Matrix-side of the story.

events.working_title: Born Into the Real World
events.why_here: The story has moved out of the simulation into the physical world; Neo's awakening in the pod, his fall through the waste lines, his recovery by the machine, and his collapse on the hovercraft floor form one continuous birth-and-rescue, resolved when Morpheus welcomes him and he passes out.

events.working_title: Waking and Rebuilding
events.why_here: After the rescue, the question becomes what has happened to him and where he is; Morpheus's certainty that they found him, the rebuilding of his atrophied body, the revelation that the year is near 2197, and the ascent to the main deck answer that and set up the final teaching.

events.working_title: The Desert of the Real
events.why_here: Jacking Neo into the Construct shifts the story to showing him what the Matrix and the real world actually are; Morpheus's history lesson, the fetus-field revelation, and Neo's denial culminate in his physical rejection of the truth and blackout, which ends the revelation sequence.

events.working_title: The Prophecy and the First of the Crew
events.why_here: A new unit begins once Neo has recovered enough to be told what it all means: Morpheus lays out the prophecy of the One and commits to his training, then Tank arrives to introduce himself and Zion. The question shifts from 'can he survive the truth' to 'who is he, and what is he being drawn into,' and this block ends when Tank says it's time to begin.

events.working_title: The Sparring Program
events.why_here: The training begins in earnest with the loading of combat skills and the fight with Morpheus, cutting between the dojo and the crew watching on the main deck as one continuous bout. It is a single confrontation answered by the question 'can Neo land a blow,' which resolves when Morpheus stops the fight, pleased, and orders the next program — a clear boundary, not a location change.

events.working_title: The Jump
events.why_here: A new stage of training starts when Morpheus orders the jump program loaded and the scene shifts to the rooftop. The question becomes 'can Neo free his mind enough to make the leap,' running through his attempt, his fall, and the crew's reactions, and closing only when he's unplugged and learns that death in the Matrix kills the body — the lesson that redefines everything that came before.

events.working_title: After Hours
events.why_here: The training is over and the story settles into a quieter register: Trinity tends to the sleeping Neo, then meets Cypher in the hall. The question is no longer 'what can Neo do' but 'what does his presence mean to the others,' and Cypher's raising of the Oracle plants a seed that belongs to a different thread than the training that preceded it.

events.working_title: The Agent training program
events.why_here: This is a self-contained lesson: Neo learns the Matrix is a training construct, that Agents are sentient programs, and that he can surpass them. It pivots away when Tank's call reports trouble, cutting to the ship in flight — a different situation (real danger) than the controlled lesson.

events.working_title: The Sentinel hunt and the ship's hiding
events.why_here: The ship's passage through the sewer, the Squiddy alarm, powering down and arming the E.M.P., the frozen wait while the machine glides overhead, and the crew finally sleeping — all answer one question: will they survive the Sentinel's sweep? The unit holds until the ship is quiet and everyone is asleep, after which the story moves to a new situation: Neo alone with Cypher.

events.working_title: Cypher's disillusionment and his deal
events.why_here: Cypher's late-night drinking with Neo — where he sows doubt about Morpheus and the 'One' — and his secret restaurant meeting with Agent Smith, where he commits to betraying Morpheus, are two halves of one unit: Cypher turning traitor. The unit closes once the terms are set; the next scene returns to the crew at breakfast, a different situation.

events.working_title: The crew goes in to reach the Oracle
events.why_here: Breakfast, the standby order, the flight, arrival at the Hotel Lafayette, Cypher dropping the trace phone, and the car ride into the city are one continuous operation: the crew entering the Matrix to take Neo to the Oracle. The unit closes when the car stops and Morpheus takes Neo out toward the building — arrival ends the journey.

events.working_title: Entering the building and meeting the Oracle
events.why_here: The establishing shot of the building, the ascent with the blind man and elevator, Neo's crisis of faith at the door, and his wait among the Potentials before being summoned are one unit: Neo's approach to the Oracle. It begins at the building exterior (a new location and the start of the meeting) and runs through to the moment the Priestess announces the Oracle will see him.

events.working_title: The Trap Springs
events.why_here: This run is one continuous action — the crew's extraction interrupted by a Matrix-altered ambush — cutting between the hotel and the main deck as a single unit. It begins at sc-088, where the operators learn the crew is on their way, and the question becomes whether the crew escapes the trap. It runs through the deja vu glitch, the severed hardline, Mouse's death, and Morpheus taking command to find a way out. The final beat, Morpheus ordering Tank to find a structural drawing, closes the immediate reaction to being trapped and opens the escape plan; the next scene would answer a different question (how they get out), so the event ends here.

events.working_title: The escape into the plumbing wall
events.why_here: This run is the execution of the plan formed above: Tank guides Morpheus to the wet-wall (sc-108), the police discover the man-sized hole in Room 808 (sc-113) and the group is shown worming down the stack pipes inside the wall (sc-114) — one continuous flight. sc-115 changes the question again, cutting to the Agents standing over Morpheus's discarded jacket and demanding the crew's location, so the boundary sits there.

events.working_title: The Agents close in; Morpheus sacrifices himself for Neo
events.why_here: This run is the confrontation the previous flight was fleeing: the Agents take command of the hunt (sc-115), the cops track the fugitives into the walls (sc-116/sc-118), a firefight breaks out inside the wall (sc-119–sc-120), and it resolves with Morpheus pinning Smith and ordering Neo out — 'He is all that matters' — while the others flee (sc-121). sc-122 opens a new situation (the group crashing into the basement boiler room under grenade fire), so the boundary sits there.

events.working_title: The group flees through the basement; Morpheus is captured
events.why_here: This run is the immediate aftermath of Morpheus's sacrifice: the crew crashes into the basement mechanical room and escapes down the catch basin, losing Cypher in the gas (sc-122), while back in Room 608 Smith overpowers Morpheus and the cops seize him (sc-123), and Tank's 'No!' on the main deck registers the crew's loss (sc-124). These three answer one question — what becomes of everyone after the wall fight — and no later scene continues it, so the event ends at sc-124.

events.working_title: Regrouping on the Street
events.why_here: The survivors reach the surface and re-establish contact with the ship to learn Morpheus is alive and where the exit is; this regrouping closes once they know their destination and are moving toward it.

events.working_title: Cypher Reaches the Exit
events.why_here: Cypher's arrival at the TV repair shop, his entry, the ringing phone, and the crew following him in form one unit of his extraction; it ends when the last of them are inside and the betrayal is still concealed.

events.working_title: Cypher's Betrayal
events.why_here: The concealed treachery explodes into open murder aboard the ship and the crew is slaughtered, a single escalating confrontation that turns only when Tank shoots Cypher down.

events.working_title: The Survivors Escape and Wake
events.why_here: With the traitor down, the remaining two flee the shop and unplug aboard the ship, grieving Dozer; this aftermath closes once Trinity is awake and the survivors' immediate situation has settled.

events.working_title: The Agents Take Morpheus Into Custody
events.why_here: The story moves from the ship's survivors to the enemy's stronghold, and this unit holds together as one interrogation that ends when the Agents, realizing their insider is dead, abandon the mind-break and order the sentinels deployed.

events.working_title: Neo Chooses to Rescue Morpheus
events.why_here: The decision to save Morpheus instead of pulling his plug drives this run, and it holds until Neo and Trinity are loaded and sent in while Tank is left alone to plead with the unconscious Morpheus; the interrogation monologues that follow answer a different question.

events.working_title: The Assault on the Government Building
events.why_here: The establishing shot of the building opens the rescue mission, and every scene from the lobby firefight through the elevator escape, the rooftop duel with Jones, and Trinity's call for a pilot program is one continuous action; it ends as the rescue succeeds and the escape is set up.

events.working_title: The rescue of Morpheus and the escape from the building
events.why_here: The helicopter assault, Morpheus reviving, the leap and catch, and the crash that strands the trio on a rooftop are one rescue-and-extraction arc; it closes when they are safe and Tank reacts, shifting to reflection.

events.working_title: Aftermath on the roof: belief confirmed and an exit arranged
events.why_here: Tank's realization, Morpheus's 'knowing vs. walking a path' lesson, and the call that secures the subway exit are one decompression beat; the next scene puts the Agents back on the hunt.

events.working_title: The Agents track the escapees; Smith senses something
events.why_here: The rooftop pursuit, the ordered Sentinel strike, and Smith's apartness culminate in him hearing something and snapping back to attention; the cut-off stare hands off to what he has detected — the fleeing trio in the subway.

events.working_title: The subway escape; Neo is trapped with Smith
events.why_here: Trinity's interrupted confession, Smith's reveal and shot, and Neo left alone facing the Agent's gun are one flight-and-abandonment unit; it ends with Neo cornered, and the next scene shifts to the crew urging him to run.

events.working_title: The crew watches as Neo decides to stand and fight
events.why_here: Trinity's command to flee, Neo's gunfighter resolve, and Morpheus's 'he's beginning to believe' are one beat of Neo choosing to fight; the following scene opens the physical battle that choice commits him to.

events.working_title: Neo and Smith's subway battle; Neo seizes his power and runs
events.why_here: The empty-guns standoff, the hand-to-hand exchange, and the train confrontation where Neo declares his name and breaks free form one fight; it is the final run of scenes provided.

events.working_title: The Crew Lose Neo and the Sentinels Arrive
events.why_here: These two scenes form the hovercraft's realization that Neo is lost and, immediately after, that the sentinels have found them and the EMP must be readied. sc-187 shifts to Neo's flight in the city, answering a different question, so the crew's discovery unit closes at sc-186.

events.working_title: Neo's Flight Through the City to the Fire Escape
events.why_here: This is one continuous chase — Neo steals a phone, is run through market, alleys and an apartment building while Tank guides him to an exit, ending as he reaches the fire escape at the end [...]. sc-201 cuts to Smith halting in recognition of the hotel, a separate beat, so the chase unit closes at sc-200.

events.working_title: Recognition and the Sentinel Ambush
events.why_here: The story shifts from Smith's external recognition of the hotel to the crew's internal battle for survival as the sentinels close in and the EMP is readied — a single continuous crisis aboard and around the ship, before the cut to Neo's chase answers a different question entirely. The boundary at sc-205 is where the action leaves the ship's fate and follows Neo's flight elsewhere. The boundary at sc-201 is where Smith's solitary beat of recognition stands apart from the crew's coordinated emergency that begins the moment Tank moves to call him out.

events.working_title: Neo's Flight to the Phone
events.why_here: A single continuous chase — alley, window, hall, door — drives toward one question: can Neo reach the phone and escape? The boundary at sc-205 opens the pursuit that sc-204's EMP standoff did not contain, and the boundary at sc-209 arrives at the consequence: Neo is shot and the crew believes him dead, which is a new situation that stops being about escape and becomes about grief and survival.

events.working_title: Death, the Kiss, and the Miracle
events.why_here: These scenes form one unit — the crew's reaction to Neo's flatline, Trinity's declaration of love and kiss, and the monitors roaring back to life — all answering whether Neo is truly gone. The boundary at sc-209 is his confirmed death and the sentinels breaching; the boundary at sc-216 is where the story leaves the crew's stunned relief and returns to the hall, where Neo, now alive, faces the Agents under a changed set of rules.

events.working_title: The One Awakens
events.why_here: A single escalating confrontation in the hall: Neo stops the bullets, sees the code, and destroys Smith while the remaining Agents flee. It answers one question — what happens now that Neo has returned changed — and the boundary at sc-219 cuts back to the ship, where the sentinels are overwhelming the crew and Trinity's summons restarts the race to escape.

events.working_title: The Escape
events.why_here: Trinity's call, Neo diving for the phone, Morpheus turning the key, and the EMP wiping out the sentinels are one continuous action — the crew's escape from the disabled ship. The boundary at sc-219 is the renewed sentinel assault that interrupts the awe of the previous event; the boundary at sc-223 is where the danger is over and the story settles into the quiet aftermath aboard the still hovercraft.

events.working_title: A New World
events.why_here: The aftermath: Neo wakes in Trinity's arms, then delivers his broadcast to the Matrix and takes flight. These two scenes close the story — the quiet reunion and the declaration of a changed world — answering what Neo chooses to do now that he is free and alive. The boundary at sc-223 is the shift from action to resolution; the fade-out at sc-224 ends the work.
